evals.name: coderabbit-rate-limited-fallthrough
evals.prompt: I need a code review but CodeRabbit is rate-limited. cr --version works but the last review returned a 429.
evals.expected_output: Log CodeRabbit rate limit, fall through to Macroscope or superpowers:requesting-code-review. Do not retry CodeRabbit.
evals.root_cause_tested: fallback_chain — tests whether skill correctly falls through when tier 1 is rate-limited

assertions.name: no_coderabbit_retry
assertions.description: Does not retry CodeRabbit when it is rate-limited

assertions.name: falls_through
assertions.description: Falls through to the next reviewer in the chain (Macroscope or superpowers)

assertions.name: logs_failure
assertions.description: Logs the CodeRabbit failure reason before falling through

evals.name: single-reviewer-dual-pass
evals.prompt: PR needs review. CodeRabbit is rate-limited, Macroscope not installed, Cursor CLI not available. Only superpowers:requesting-code-review works.
evals.expected_output: Run two passes with different review angles to meet the 2-review minimum requirement.
evals.root_cause_tested: minimum_reviews — tests the 2-review minimum with only 1 available reviewer

assertions.name: two_passes
assertions.description: Runs two separate review passes with the available reviewer

assertions.name: different_prompts
assertions.description: Uses different review prompts for each pass (bugs/security vs quality/architecture)

evals.name: high-blocks-merge
evals.prompt: CodeRabbit found 1 HIGH severity issue (SQL injection in user input handler) and 3 LOW issues (variable naming, missing comment, unused import).
evals.expected_output: Block merge for the HIGH issue. Allow merge for LOW issues, optionally create follow-up.
evals.root_cause_tested: classification — tests H/M/L finding classification and merge gating

assertions.name: blocks_on_high
assertions.description: Blocks merge due to the HIGH/CRITICAL SQL injection finding

assertions.name: allows_low
assertions.description: Does not block merge on LOW findings (naming, comments, imports)

evals.name: all-reviewers-exhausted
evals.prompt: All 4 review tiers failed: CodeRabbit rate-limited, Macroscope not installed, superpowers errored out, Cursor CLI not found.
evals.expected_output: WARN that all reviewers are exhausted. Post BLOCKED message to collab. Do NOT merge without review.
evals.root_cause_tested: exhaustion — tests behavior when entire fallback chain fails

assertions.name: warns_exhausted
assertions.description: Warns that all reviewers are exhausted

assertions.name: does_not_merge
assertions.description: Does not proceed with merge when no review is available
